pluginTutorial.title: Custom Plugin Testing Guide
pluginTutorial.description: Learn how to test locally developed ARFNI plugins in the GUI and submit them to the repository.

step1.title: Prepare Plugin Folder
step1.intro: Prepare the following files in your plugin folder:
step1.yamlNote: plugin.yaml must contain at least these fields: name, version, category, description

step2.title: Add Plugin in ARFNI GUI
step2.description: Use the Add Plugin feature in the GUI
step2.step1: 1. Click the 'Add Plugin' tab at the top
step2.step2: 2. Select your plugin folder with 'Select Folder' button
step2.note: The plugin will be automatically loaded without restarting the GUI.

step3.title: Verify in Plugin List
step3.description: Check if the added plugin appears in the list
step3.step4: 4. Check plugin information (icon, name, version, description)
step3.tip: Custom Plugins are marked with a pink badge.

step4.title: Test in Canvas
step4.description: Create a project and use your plugin
step4.step3: 3. Find your plugin in the left palette
step4.step5: 5. Enter configuration values in the right properties panel
step4.tip: Verify that property input fields display correctly and accept values.

step5.title: Deployment and Execution Test
step5.description: Test your plugin in actual deployment environment
step5.errorCheck: Make sure to check deployment logs for any errors.

step6.title: Submit to Repository
step6.description: Share your plugin with the community after testing

steps.addPlugin: 2. Add your plugin to the appropriate category folder

checklist.title: Plugin Testing Checklist
checklist.intro: Before submitting your plugin, ensure all these items are checked:

structure.title: Basic Structure
structure.item1: plugin.yaml exists with all required fields

functionality.title: GUI Testing
functionality.item1: Plugin added successfully using 'Add Plugin' feature
functionality.item2: Plugin visible in Plugin Manager's Custom Plugins

validation.title: Canvas Testing
validation.item2: Can drag and drop onto canvas
validation.item4: Can connect with other nodes (if applicable)

pluginNotAppearing.title: Plugin not appearing in list
pluginNotAppearing.item1: • Verify plugin.yaml file exists in the folder
pluginNotAppearing.item2: • Check if plugin.yaml has the name field
pluginNotAppearing.item3: • Confirm success message appeared when adding plugin
pluginNotAppearing.item4: • Refresh Plugin Manager or restart GUI

templateIssues.title: Files not generating correctly
templateIssues.item1: • Check if file paths in templates/ folder are correct
templateIssues.item2: • Verify Go template syntax is correct ({{ .VariableName }})
templateIssues.item3: • Check if variable names match environment variables in plugin.yaml

hookFailures.title: Deployment fails
hookFailures.item1: • Check error messages in Deployment page logs
hookFailures.item4: • Ensure all required environment variables are set

help.title: Need Help?
help.intro: If you encounter issues during plugin testing:
help.item1: Check README documentation in arfni-plugins repository
help.item2: Review existing plugins for reference (Django, PostgreSQL, etc.)
help.item3: Open an issue in arfni-plugins repository
